inventory.units_note: parent inventory units are the full pinned inventory; scored units are recomputed from the selected phase subset.  Declared query rows are not inventory case rows; inventory case rows become arm-expanded metric rows by variants x layers x kind-eligible arms

exact_key_value_diagnostic.note: mixture diagnostic over a gold key readout; exact-key rows exist only for fact targets and are never added to candidate quality

oracle_diagnostic.note: gold-target diagnostic population gated as answerable-fact recoverability, not an upper bound and never a legal policy

diagnostics.note: The oracle gate uses answerable-fact recoverability; unknown and revoked cases are excluded from that denominator.  The total-group raw top-1 rate is descriptive only.  Zero and tied readouts keep their observed top-1 flag for audit but never receive recoverability or acceptance credit.  When refresh evidence is absent, causal/oracle blocks are explicit full-state or mixture fallbacks; equality is reported, not hidden.  Runtime selection metrics are unavailable when the raw artifact predates decision rows.
